claim_boundary.authorized_if_confirmation_passes: On previously unseen PoseIt household objects, decision-directed selection among logged pre-shake holding-pose probes reduces held-shake decision regret more efficiently than task-agnostic system identification while abstaining when no holding pose is certified stable.
not_authorized: safety certification outside the released PoseIt setup
causal identification of object material parameters
claim_boundary.physical_unit: one previously unseen PoseIt household object
claim_boundary.scope_note: Logged-policy evaluation supports a real-data decision claim, not a claim that the selector was deployed online.

assignment.rule: Normalize each archive-derived object token with NFKC, casefold, and surrounding-whitespace removal; sort by SHA-256(domain_separator || NUL || token), breaking digest ties by token; assign the first 10 to fit, next 5 to calibration, next 5 to source_test, and final 6 to confirmation.

cohort.assignment_time: after archive hash and structure-only qualification, before any phase label or outcome-bearing payload is decoded

roles.calibration: calibrate one shared object-level lower-stability certificate without selecting the method
roles.confirmation: one-shot confirmation only after the source gate and exact method seal authorize it
roles.fit: fit the shared latent-response model and all fit-only preprocessing
roles.source_test: single source-side promotion decision with no method changes afterward

license_boundary.analysis_policy: academic analysis with attribution; do not redistribute raw archive bytes until the release terms are clarified
license_boundary.status: publicly released with inconsistent repository license signals

dataset.name: PoseIt: A Visual-Tactile Dataset of Holding Poses for Grasp Stability Analysis

secondary_archive.reason: avoid sensor-release mixing and duplicated scientific units in the primary test

decision.action_set: all structurally available non-reference holding poses 2 through 16
decision.held_intervention: the manually annotated shake-phase outcome for the chosen holding pose
decision.oracle: choose the lexicographically first structurally available pose with a Pass shake label, or abstain if none passes
decision.policy: choose the lexicographically first pose whose simultaneous calibrated lower stability bound is at least 0.5; abstain if no pose is certified
decision.regret: oracle utility minus realized policy utility

budgets.cost_unit: one logged pre-shake sensory record at one non-reference holding pose
budgets.primary_summary: trapezoidal area under object-level decision regret versus additional-probe count

controls: exact average over a preregistered common-random-number set of fixed probe orders
evaluation.primary_contrast: decision-directed regret AUC minus task-agnostic system-identification regret AUC
secondary_metrics: regret at each matched probe count

statistical_inference.primary_test: one-sided exact paired sign-flip test over six confirmation objects
statistical_inference.within_object_aggregation: mean across complete grasp-location by gripper-force families before object-level inference

episode_family.nesting: object by grasp location by gripper force
episode_family.required_anchor: a structurally complete pre-shake record at reference pose 1
episode_family.structurally_unavailable_action: exclude from both the policy and oracle action sets without consulting its shake label
episode_family.unit_inclusion: include every archive family with a valid anchor; never select families using phase labels

allowed: RGB-D observations through the end of the one-second holding-pose wait
GelSight observations through the end of the one-second holding-pose wait
wrist force and torque through the end of the one-second holding-pose wait
joint angle and velocity through the end of the one-second holding-pose wait
forbidden: any grasp, pose, shake, or retract phase label at probe-selection time
future samples after the registered end-of-pose cutoff
feature_boundary.mapping_requirement: the exact archive paths, timestamps, resampling, missingness encoding, and fixed-dimensional feature map must be frozen after structure-only inspection and before any label decode

model_family.posterior: registered Bayesian latent-response posterior shared across poses and conditioned only on the anchor plus selected pre-shake probes
model_family.required_property: both selectors share the identical posterior and differ only in their acquisition objective

decision_directed.objective: maximum expected reduction in downstream Bayes decision regret per additional pose probe

system_identification.objective: maximum mutual information about the full still-unobserved latent response vector, independent of downstream utility

shared_certificate.score: maximum one-sided stability shortfall over every registered selector, budget, and structurally available pose, aggregated within object before calibration

promotion.target_failure_policy: freeze and report without retry, replacement, calibration, or method change
